name: Rotmarchy
author: AndresSM415
description: Click the brain in your bar and a random brainrot video appears somewhere on screen, cropped to a phone shape and silent. Click again for another one.

barWidget.description: One button, one behaviour: every click opens another silent phone-shaped video at a random spot on the screen. Minecraft parkour, Family Guy, Subway Surfers or GTA ramps, seeked to a random timestamp. Press q on a window to close it.

schema.label: Category
schema.description: Which flavour of brainrot the button summons.

schema.label: Video height
schema.description: Resolution the video is fetched and cropped at. The window itself is shown at 60% of this, so 720 fetches a 405x720 phone-shaped crop and displays it in a 243x432 window.
